POLICIES.subject: Grade scheme
POLICIES.policy_text: Regular school grades 1–12 use Annex 1 of Letter Grading Directive 2083.

POLICIES.subject: Historical cohort
POLICIES.policy_text: Annex 2 applies specifically to grade-improvement candidates who sat as regular examinees in academic session 2079.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Do not use D+/E mapping for regular pupils.

POLICIES.subject: Credit hour
POLICIES.policy_text: 1 credit hour equals 32 working hours.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Annual working hours = total credit hours × 32.

POLICIES.subject: Period duration
POLICIES.policy_text: One class period has 60 minutes; schools can reorganize without lowering annual working hours.

POLICIES.subject: Credit-eligible activities
POLICIES.policy_text: Direct learning interactions, collaborative learning and extracurricular activities count toward credit hours.

POLICIES.subject: Attendance
POLICIES.policy_text: At least 75% of total open/instruction days' attendance required for participation in summative assessment, except alternative/open-school rules.

POLICIES.subject: Practical time
POLICIES.policy_text: Evaluate practical work using activities and extracurricular work scheduled for practical credit hours.

POLICIES.subject: Separate sections
POLICIES.policy_text: Theory and internal marks are to be recorded separately and each converted to a letter grade.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Never combine raw marks before section grading.

POLICIES.subject: Descriptors
POLICIES.policy_text: The grade description must be shown on the grade sheet.

POLICIES.subject: Certificate
POLICIES.policy_text: For further study, grade sheet with GPA and original certificate are required.

POLICIES.subject: Certificate gate
POLICIES.policy_text: Original certificate issued only once the minimum grade in all subjects has been achieved.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Apply TH ≥ D and IN ≥ C where both apply.

POLICIES.subject: Section minimum
POLICIES.policy_text: Minimum TH grade D (35%) and IN grade C (40%) for an original certificate.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Do not pass solely on average grade.

POLICIES.subject: School issuer
POLICIES.policy_text: Schools may issue grade sheets/certificates for other classes consistent with Directive 2083.

POLICIES.subject: Grade improvement
POLICIES.policy_text: Absent or NG students may sit opportunity/grade-improvement exam in the corresponding failed/absent subject.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Do not blindly enforce the older Word's maximum-two-subject rule.

POLICIES.subject: Internal mark retention
POLICIES.policy_text: If a student participated in internal evaluation but missed external assessment, internal/practical marks remain valid for up to three years.

POLICIES.subject: Re-exam limit
POLICIES.policy_text: A candidate not meeting prescribed minimum can sit annual examination in that subject for up to three years.

POLICIES.subject: Internal requirement
POLICIES.policy_text: Exam may be cancelled if student took annual/external exam without obtaining prescribed internal minimum grade.

POLICIES.subject: Foreign boards
POLICIES.policy_text: Grade conversion of students from foreign boards also uses this directive.

POLICIES.subject: Previous scheme
POLICIES.policy_text: Directive 2078 repealed; its actions are deemed carried out under directive 2083.

POLICIES.subject: Thematic assessment
POLICIES.policy_text: Obtain thematic achievement percentages from achieved learning outcome marks vs possible marks, after additional support.

POLICIES.subject: No grade improvement
POLICIES.policy_text: The Word notes remedial teaching for learning levels 1 or 2 rather than a grade improvement exam.

POLICIES.subject: Trimester IN total
POLICIES.policy_text: Quarterly IN components: participation 4, practical/project 36, trimester test 10; total 50.

POLICIES.subject: Annual IN total
POLICIES.policy_text: Annual IN components: participation 4, practical/project 36, first trimester 5, second trimester 5; total 50.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Each quarterly exam 50→10 then semester contribution 5.

POLICIES.subject: Annual theory
POLICIES.policy_text: External/theory evaluation 50 marks; grade both sections separately.

POLICIES.subject: Trimester IN total
POLICIES.policy_text: Quarterly IN: participation 3, practical/project 16, quarterly test 6; total 25.

POLICIES.subject: Annual IN total
POLICIES.policy_text: Annual IN: participation 3, practical/project 16, trimester 1 three marks and trimester 2 three marks; total 25.

POLICIES.subject: Annual theory
POLICIES.policy_text: External is 75 marks for sample subjects, while high-practical subjects like computer science may use a 50-mark external assessment.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Do not derive 50/75 exceptions without course-specific source.

POLICIES.subject: Subject final GP
POLICIES.policy_text: WGP_TH = CH_TH × GP_TH; WGP_IN = CH_IN × GP_IN; final subject GP = (WGP_TH + WGP_IN)/total subject CH.

POLICIES.subject: Class GPA
POLICIES.policy_text: Class GPA = sum of all subject/section WGP / sum of credit hours for the class.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Report and rounding to be confirmed.

POLICIES.subject: Old two-NG provision
POLICIES.policy_text: Word sample states a limit of two NG/absent subjects for grade-improvement eligibility; Directive 2083 SEE section does not state this cap.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Do not enforce old 2-subject limit globally.

POLICIES.subject: Old final GP bands
POLICIES.policy_text: The Word illustrates final GPA-to-letter intervals in increments of 0.40 (3.61-4=A+, 3.21-3.60=A, etc.).
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: PDF 2083 defines percentage-grade mapping; GP-to-final-letter bands are from Word.

POLICIES.subject: Extra credit
POLICIES.policy_text: The Word's Grade 11/12 grade-sheet template contains an Extra Credit Subject section without a stated effect on class GPA.
POLICIES.ERP_implementation: Do not assume extra-credit CH enter GPA without rules.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Word provides a Class 11 six-subject example and general Grade 11/12 instructions, not a distinct Class 12 subject catalogue.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Class 12 rows are flagged NO_VERIFY_12; identical credits shown only as an illustrative candidate, not verified official defaults.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Only six example subjects are listed; all electives/codes/subject catalogues are not provided.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Do not treat sample electives Physics/Biology/Chemistry as exhaustive or mandatory.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Grade 9/10 elaboration uses 206 for Optional II Science; annual grade-sheet template uses 202.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Main sheet uses 202 as displayed in grade sheet; verify intended national subject code before import.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Word says GPA 98.2/27 = 3.63; exact quotient ~3.637037, rounded to two places 3.64.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Workbook calculates ordinary ROUND=3.64 and preserves reported 3.63 in audit.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Word says 23.8/6.75 = 3.52; exact ~3.525926, ordinarily rounded to 3.53.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Preserve both numbers, confirm whether Word truncates rather than rounds.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Directive 2083 defines grade points but does not explicitly prescribe subject combined GP or GPA display rounding in its provided pages.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Calculator uses configurable-style ordinary two-decimal rounding for illustration; confirm with competent authority.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: The Word has combined grade bands 3.61–4.00, 3.21–3.60 etc; PDF 2083 Annex 1 only maps obtained percentages to GP/grade.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Final combined-GP bands are Word-derived, not independently prescribed by Annex 1.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Annex 2 includes D+ and E, limited specifically to 2079 SEE grade-improvement cohort.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Isolated in LEGACY_2079; exclude from 2083 production grading.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Word says up to two NG/absent subjects; PDF 2083 §6(2)(d) permits SEE opportunity exam for NG/absent subjects without specifying a numerical cap.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Avoid hard-coding old two-subject cap without confirmation.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Only whole-subject credit hours are supplied; no IN or TH breakdown.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Keep both internal CH and theory CH blank (not zero) and do not apply a fictitious split.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Theme achievement is a percentage of observed learning outcomes, not standardized 100 marks.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Calculator uses input achievement percent, not 100-mark exam.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Local Subject/Mother Tongue/Sanskrit is an either-or choice, not three simultaneous subjects.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Import one configured choice per child.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Optional I Mathematics and Optional II Science are sample option choices, not all possibilities.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Review elective choices and subject codes before school-wide import.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Word allows 50-mark written assessment in some practical-heavy subjects (computer science etc.) vs sample 75.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Do not force all 11/12 subjects to 75/25 without approved subject-specific specification.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Much Nepali prose of the Word is typed with a legacy Preeti font; raw textual extraction appears Romanized.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Raw text archived untouched; English tables used for exact numeric roster.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Word emphasizes remedial support/no grade improvement for Levels 1–2, while Annex 1 provides NG for <35 across 1–12.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Treat growth/remedial workflow separately from report-card grade bands.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Even a combined subject GP that is acceptable cannot override IN below 40 or TH below 35.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Calculator status gate checks both independently.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Source grade-sheet samples for Grades 1–8 have no numeric official subject codes.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Leave code empty; do not invent codes.

AUDIT.what_the_sources_say: Directive 2083 states it takes effect on ministry approval, but the supplied PDF does not visibly identify a separate approval date.
AUDIT.recommended_handling: Confirm formal approval/effective date when configuring historical student reports.

DESCRIPTORS_2083.official_full_english_descriptor: Has deep and broad knowledge with highly-developed critical insight as well as comprehensive and perceptive appreciation of the theoretical or practical subject matter; an exceptional ability to organize, use, analyze and succinctly present subject matter fluently and clearly with extraordinary performance; a significant capacity for original, creative and logical thinking with superior communication skills.

Has deep and broad knowledge with developed critical insight as well as comprehensive and perceptive appreciation of the theoretical or practical subject matter; an exceptional ability to organize, use, analyze and succinctly present subject matter fluently and clearly with exemplary performance; a significant capacity for original, creative and logical thinking with advanced communication skills.

Has broad knowledge with developed insight as well as comprehensive and independent appreciation of the theoretical or practical subject matter; a special ability to organize, use, analyze and succinctly present subject matter clearly with a high level of performance; a highly-developed capacity for original, creative and logical thinking with sound communication skills.

Has decent knowledge with developed insight as well as comprehensive and good appreciation of the theoretical or practical subject matter; an ability to organize, use, analyze and succinctly present subject matter with respectable performance; a developed capacity for original, creative and logical thinking with reasonable communication skills.

Has adequate knowledge with developing insight as well as comprehensive and reasonably good appreciation of the theoretical or practical subject matter; an ability to organize, use, analyze and succinctly present subject matter with blameless performance; some capacity for original, creative and logical thinking with sufficient communication skills.

Has sufficient knowledge with developing insight as well as comprehensive and acceptable understanding of the theoretical or practical subject matter; an ability to organize, use, analyze and present subject matter with guiltless performance; limited capacity for original, creative and logical thinking with acceptable communication skills.

Has some knowledge with developing insight as well as comprehensive and partial understanding of the theoretical or practical subject matter; limited ability to organize, use, analyze and present subject matter with guiltless performance; limited capacity for original, creative and logical thinking with minimal participation in communication skills.

Has less knowledge with incomplete insight as well as comprehensive and negligible understanding of the theoretical or practical subject matter; seriously deficient ability to organize, use, analyze and present subject matter; very limited capacity for original, creative and logical thinking with inadequate communication skills.

LEGACY_DESC.title: Outstanding
LEGACY_DESC.complete_source_english_description: Exceptional evidence of understanding and summarizing the subject matter; demonstration of extraordinary performance in problem-solving, creativity, critical expression and participation; exceptionally independent in learning and organizing content with superior communication skills.

LEGACY_DESC.title: Excellent
LEGACY_DESC.complete_source_english_description: Excellent Strong evidence of understanding and summarizing the subject matter; demonstration of exemplary performance in problem-solving, creativity, critical expression and participation; admirably independent in learning and organizing content with advanced communication skills.

LEGACY_DESC.title: Very Good
LEGACY_DESC.complete_source_english_description: Very good evidence of understanding and summarizing the subject matter; demonstration of higher performance in problem-solving, creativity, critical expression and participation; greatly independent in learning and organizing content with sound communication skills.

LEGACY_DESC.title: Good
LEGACY_DESC.complete_source_english_description: Good evidence of understanding and summarizing the subject matter; demonstration of reasonably good independent performance in problem-solving, creativity, critical expression and participation; very independent in learning and organizing content with reasonable communication skills.

LEGACY_DESC.title: Satisfactory
LEGACY_DESC.complete_source_english_description: Adequate evidence of understanding and summarizing the subject matter; demonstration of reasonably good but not particularly independent performance in problem-solving, creativity, critical expression and participation; reasonably independent in learning and organizing content with sufficient communication skills.

LEGACY_DESC.title: Acceptable
LEGACY_DESC.complete_source_english_description: Sufficient evidence of understanding and summarizing the subject matter; demonstration of acceptable performance in problem-solving, creativity, critical expression and participation; reasonably independent in learning and organizing content with satisfactory communication skills.

LEGACY_DESC.title: Partially acceptable
LEGACY_DESC.complete_source_english_description: Some evidence of understanding and summarizing the subject matter; demonstration of limited performance in problem-solving, creativity, critical expression and participation; partially independent in learning and organizing content with basic communication skills.

LEGACY_DESC.title: Insufficient
LEGACY_DESC.complete_source_english_description: Minimal evidence of understanding and summarizing the subject matter; demonstration of deficient performance in problem-solving, creativity, critical expression and participation; needs close supervision in learning and organizing content with minimal communication skills.

LEGACY_DESC.title: Very insufficient
LEGACY_DESC.complete_source_english_description: Negligible evidence of understanding and summarizing the subject matter; seriously deficient performance in problem-solving, creativity, critical expression and very minimal participation; needs constant supervision in learning and organizing content with inadequate communication skills.
